wikipedia#4.title: 1987: Singapore's first Mass Rapid Transit line opened, with train services running between Yio Chu Kang and Toa Payoh.

wikipedia#5.title: 1972: A ship collision with the Sidney Lanier Bridge in the U.S. state of Georgia resulted in a bridge collapse (pictured), which killed ten people.

wikipedia#6.title: 1949: Oil was discovered in the Caspian Sea off the coast of Azerbaijan, leading to the construction of Neft Daşları, the world's first offshore oil platform.

wikipedia#7.title: 1934: The first specimens of the tufted jay (pictured) to be scientifically described were collected in Mexico.

wikipedia#8.title: 1917: World War I: British forces captured Gaza following the retreat of the Ottoman garrison.

wikipedia#9.title: 1916: Jeannette Rankin (pictured) became the first woman to be elected to the United States House of Representatives.

wikipedia#10.title: 1893: Between 20 and 30 people in the Grand Lyceum Theatre in Barcelona were killed in a terrorist attack  by Spanish anarchist Santiago Salvador.

wikipedia#11.title: 1861: American Civil War: Future U.S. president Ulysses S. Grant engaged in his first combat leadership role in the Battle of Belmont in Mississippi County, Missouri.

wikipedia#12.title: 1837: American abolitionist Elijah Parish Lovejoy was murdered by a pro-slavery mob in Alton, Illinois, during an attack to destroy his printing press and abolitionist materials.

wikipedia#13.title: 1825: Jereboam O. Beauchamp murdered Kentucky legislator Solomon P. Sharp; Beauchamp later became the first person legally executed in the state.

wikipedia#14.title: 1811: Tecumseh's War: American forces led by William Henry Harrison defeated the forces of Shawnee leader Tecumseh's growing confederation at the Battle of Tippecanoe near present-day Battle Ground, Indiana.

wikipedia#15.title: 1723: O Ewigkeit, du Donnerwort, BWV 60, a dialogue cantata by Johann Sebastian Bach for Leipzig, was first performed.

wikipedia#16.title: 680: The Third Council of Constantinople convened to settle the Christological controversies of monoenergism and monothelitism.
